examples.text: suṇātu me bhante saṅgho ajj'uposatho pannaraso yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyya'ti etasmiñ'hi re-kāre anatikkanteyeva ṭhapetuṃ labbhati. tato paraṃ pana yya-kāre patte na labbhati. esa nayo pavāraṇāya.
anomā nāma, devā'ti. amhākam'pi pabbajjā anomā bhavissatī'ti paṇhiyā ghaṭṭento assassa saññaṃ adāsi. asso ca uppatitvā aṭṭhusabhavitthārāya nadiyā pārimatīre aṭṭhāsi.

89502.meaning1: to explain; to comment on (something with)

examples.text: tadanantaraṃ ther'āpadāna-saṅgaha-gāthāyo saṃvaṇṇetuṃ atha ther'āpadānaṃ suṇāthā'ti āha.
yaṃ yaṃ suttan'ti vā yathāsuttaṃ, sabbaṃ suttan'ti attho. nettinayena hi saṃvaṇṇetuṃ asakkuṇeyyaṃ nāma suttaṃ n'atthī'ti.

sekho appattamānaso'ti adhisīlasikkh'ādīnaṃ sikkhanato sekho. anavasesato mānaṃ siyati samucchindatī'ti mānaso, aggamaggo, taṃnibbattito mānasato āgataṃ mānasaṃ, arahattaṃ, taṃ, so vā appatto etenā'ti appattamānaso.

89504.commentary: (PVa) ko attho supanena te'ti supanena tuyhaṃ kā nāma vaḍḍhi.

examples.text: uṭṭhehi kaṇha kiṃ sesi, ko attho supanena te, yo ca tuyhaṃ sako bhātā, hadayaṃ cakkhu ca dakkhiṇaṃ, tassa vātā balīyanti, sasaṃ jappati kesavā'ti.
suttaṃ gāman'ti gāmassa gehabhitti-ādīnaṃ pana supanavasena supanaṃ nāma n'atthi, sattānaṃ pana suttapamattataṃ upādāya sutto nāma hoti.
uyyojeti āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti-ādikā saṅgh'ādisesa-pariyosānā āpattiyo kassā hontī'ti? uyyojikāya.

89506.meaning1: (gram) having changed; having altered; having inverted
89506.meaningLit: having caused to completely bend around

examples.text: tathā hī'ti yathā tuyhaṃ mayhañ'ca imassa dukkhassa n'atthi anto, na anto paṭidissati, tathā tena pakārena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ pakataṃ tayā mayā cā'ti vibhattiṃ vipariṇāmetvā vattabbaṃ.

89507.commentary: (JAa) na ghaṃsitun'ti nhāpiyamāno sarīram'pi ghaṃsituṃ n'ālaṃ. evaṃ yaṃ yaṃ so hatthī kātuṃ na samattho, taṃ taṃ sabbaṃ rañño ārocetvā tassa asamatthabhāve attanā sallakkhitakāraṇaṃ ārocento maññāmī'ti-ādim'āha.

examples.text: n'ālaṃ kabaḷaṃ padātave, na ca piṇḍaṃ na kuse na ghaṃsituṃ, maññāmi abhiṇhadassanā, nāgo sneham'akāsi kukkure'ti.
ukkāsikan'ti vatthavaṭṭiṃ, tasmā nhāyantassa yassa kassaci nhānasāṭakavaṭṭiyā piṭṭhiṃ ghaṃsituṃ vaṭṭati.
tattha lokīyati vicittākārato dissatī'ti cakkavāḷasaṅkhāto loko okāsaloko, saṅkhāro lujjati palujjatī'ti loko, lokīyati ettha puññapāpaṃ tabbipāko cā'ti sattaloko.

89509.meaning1: is comprehended; is understood; is penetrated (by)

examples.text: ñāyati nicchayena kamati nibbānaṃ, taṃ vā ñāyati paṭivijjhīyati etenā'ti ñāyo, ariyamaggo'ti āha ñāyo vuccati ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo'ti.

89510.meaning1: insatiable; never fed up (with); never having had enough (of)

examples.text: dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṃ karoti. katamesaṃ dvinnaṃ?
bhave saṃsaramānassa, puññakammasamaṅgino, manasā patthitaṃ sabbaṃ, nibbattissati tāva'd'e.

89512.synonym: abhimukhībhūta, pavattaka, pavattanaka, pavattanta, pavattamāna, pavattiyamāna, vattamāna, vattamānaka, sambhuṇanta

examples.text: ubhato vacīsaṃsāro'ti dvīsu'pi pakkhesu aññam'aññaṃ akkosana-paccakkosana-vasena saṃsaramānā vācā vacīsaṃsāro.
ekādasame āmisassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ āmisasannicayo, dhammassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ dhammasannicayo.

tikicchakā, bhikkhave, virecanaṃ denti pittasamuṭṭhānānam'pi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, semhasamuṭṭhānānam'pi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya, vātasamuṭṭhānānam'pi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya. atth'etaṃ, bhikkhave, virecanaṃ, n'etaṃ n'atthī'ti vadāmi.

89515.meaningLit: to cause to be gone out
89515.commentary: (VINa) nissāraṇīyaṃ paññattan'ti bhaṇḍanakārak'ādayo yena kammena nissārīyanti, taṃ kammaṃ paññattan'ti attho.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, atthavase paṭicca tathāgatena sāvakānaṃ… nissāraṇīyaṃ paññattaṃ… upasampadā paññattā… ñattikammaṃ paññattaṃ… ñattidutiyakammaṃ paññattaṃ… ñatticatutthakammaṃ paññattaṃ…

yo'pi so, bhikkhave, rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā so'pi na arājakaṃ cakkaṃ vattetī'ti. evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko pana, bhante, rañño cakkavattissa dhammikassa dhammarañño rājā'ti?
atha kho, brāhmaṇa dhammika, sakko devānam'indo tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi, yathā bhusā vātavuṭṭhi āgantvā suppatiṭṭhaṃ nigrodharājaṃ pavattesi ummūlam'akāsi.
atha kho, bhikkhave, rathakāro yaṃ taṃ cakkaṃ chahi divasehi niṭṭhitaṃ taṃ pavattesi. taṃ pavattitaṃ samānaṃ yāvatikā abhisaṅkhārassa gati tāvatikaṃ gantvā ciṅgulāyitvā bhūmiyaṃ papati.

89519.meaning1: difficult to remove; hard to extract

examples.text: duppajahā'ti duccajā dunnīharā. lābh'āsāya duppajahabhāvena sattā dasa'pi vassāni vīsati'pi saṭṭhi'pi vassāni ajja labhissāma, sve labhissāmā'ti rājānaṃ upaṭṭhahanti, kasikamm'ādīni karonti, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti, ajapatha-saṅkupath'ādayo paṭipajjanti, nāvāya mahāsamuddaṃ pavisanti.

89520.meaning1: being hospitable; receiving in a friendly manner (with)

examples.text: catutthe sākhalyan'ti saṇhavācāvasena sammodamānabhāvo. paṭisanthāro'ti āmisena vā dhammena vā paṭisantharaṇaṃ.

89521.meaning1: being hospitable; receiving in a friendly manner; providing (with requisites)

examples.text: catutthassa paṭhame catūhi paccayehi attano ca parassa ca antarapaṭicchādanavasena santharaṇaṃ āmisasanthāro, dhammena santharaṇaṃ dhammasanthāro.
te naṃ bhogehi nipatanti, ito, samma pāpaṇika, bhoge karitvā puttadārañ'ca posehi, amhākañ'ca kālena kālaṃ anuppadehī'ti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpaṇiko nissayasampanno hoti.

89523.meaning1: journey has been undertaken; road is travelled (by)

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti. tassa evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilanto, hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti!

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vajirassa n'atthi kiñci abhejjaṃ maṇi vā pāsāṇo vā, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā … upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo adhiko hoti sīlena samādhinā paññāya. evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo sakkatvā garuṃ katvā sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
imesaṃ kho, gahapati, pañcannaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ āyācanahetu vā patthanāhetu vā paṭilābho abhavissa, ko idha kena hāyetha?
yāni kho pana tāni sekkhasammatāni kulānī'ti sekkhasammataṃ nāma kulaṃ yaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati, bhogena hāyati. evarūpassa kulassa ñattidutiyena kammena sekkhasammuti dinnā hoti.

so tasmiṃ āsane nisinno tassā kathāya n'eva ādiṃ manasi karoti, na majjhaṃ manasi karoti, na pariyosānaṃ manasi karoti, vuṭṭhito'pi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya n'ev'ādiṃ manasi karoti, na majjhaṃ manasi karoti, na pariyosānaṃ manasi karoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, avakujjapañño puggalo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisassa ucchaṅge nānākhajjakāni ākiṇṇāni, tilā taṇḍulā modakā badarā. so tamhā āsanā vuṭṭhahanto satisammosā pakireyya.

ime, bhante, licchavikumārakā caṇḍā pharusā apānubhā. yāni'pi tāni kulesu paheṇakāni pahīyanti, ucchū'ti vā badarā'ti vā pūvā'ti vā modakā'ti vā saṃkulikā'ti vā, tāni vilumpitvā vilumpitvā khādanti, kul'itthīnam'pi kulakumārīnam'pi pacch'āliyaṃ khipanti.

89529.meaning1: what was learned; what has been grasped

examples.text: ādiṃ kathāya majjhañ'ca, pariyosānañ'ca tādiso, nisinno āsane tasmiṃ, uggahetvāna byañjanaṃ, vuṭṭhito nappajānāti, gahitaṃ hi'ssa mussati.
kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti, kusalesu dhammesu suggahitaggāhī ca, bahuñ'ca gaṇhāti, gahitañ'c'assa nappamussatī'ti? āyasmā kho ānando bahussuto.

89531.grammar: pron, masc & nt abl pl of eta

examples.text: puthupañño ca puriso, seyyo etehi vuccati, abhikkhaṇam'pi ce hoti, gantā bhikkhūna santike.

89532.commentary: (ANa) seyyo etena vuccatī'ti etasmā puggalā uttaritaro'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ucchaṅgapañño puriso, seyyo etena vuccati, abhikkhaṇam'pi ce hoti, gantā bhikkhūna santike.

89533.meaning1: for my benefit; for my good; just for me
89533.commentary: (ANa) yāva'd'eva mam'atthāyā'ti ettha yāva'd'evā'ti payojanā-vadhi-niyāma-vacanaṃ, yāva mam'eva atthāya, n'atth'ettha aññaṃ kāraṇan'ti attho.

examples.text: mama sudaṃ, bhikkhave, pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti. ekattha sudaṃ, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vappati, ekattha padumaṃ, ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ, yāva'd'eva mam'atthāya.

89534.commentary: (MNa) vāsīhī'ti mahāsuppapamāṇāhi vāsīhi. tāhi tacchantā tacato yāva aṭṭhīni saṇikaṃ tacchanti, tacchitaṃ tacchitaṃ paṭipākatikaṃ hoti. (ANa) vāsīhī'ti mahāsuppappamāṇāhi vāsīhi.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā vāsīhi tacchanti … tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādittāya bhūmiyā sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya sārenti'pi paccāsārenti'pi …
bhāvanāya mahāpaññā, suten'eva sutāvinī, mānena nīcakulajā, na hi kammaṃ vinassati.
ayam'antimā jātī'ti ayaṃ sabbapacchimā jāti. n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti idāni me puna paṭisandhi nāma n'atthī'ti evaṃ paccavekkhaṇañāṇam'pi me uppannan'ti dasseti.
mataṃ mataṃ eva rodatha, na hi taṃ rodatha yo marissati, sabbe'pi sarīradhārino, anupubbena jahanti jīvitaṃ.
dve brāhmaṇā caññataro, paribbājakena nibbutaṃ, palokavaccho tikaṇṇo, soṇi saṅgāravena cā'ti.

89539.construction: pati > paty > pacc + ā + gaccha + nta

examples.text: pubbekataṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sārato paccāgacchataṃ na hoti chando vā vāyāmo vā idaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ idaṃ vā akaraṇīyan'ti. iti karaṇīy'ākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo.
kena saṃvaravattena, sañjāte abhitiṭṭhasi, kena taṃ n'ātivattanti, ñātisaṅghā samāgatā.

89541.meaning1: belonging to a fortified town; living in a citadel

examples.text: assosuṃ kho venāgapurikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito venāgapuraṃ anuppatto.
na maṇḍanāyā'ti na antepurikavesiy'ādayo viya maṇḍan'atthaṃ, aṅgapaccaṅgānaṃ pīṇabhāvanimittan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

nappaṭibalo hoti bhesajjaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ, sappāy'āsappāyaṃ na jānāti, asappāyaṃ upanāmeti, sappāyaṃ apanāmeti, āmis'antaro gilānaṃ upaṭṭhāti, no mettacitto, jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā vantaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā nīharituṃ, nappaṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ.
aham'p'ajja imañ'ca rattiṃ imañ'ca divasaṃ pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharāmi.

89544.meaning1: people of eastern Bengal; eastern Bengalis

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, aṅgānaṃ, magadhānaṃ, kāsīnaṃ, kosalānaṃ, vajjīnaṃ, mallānaṃ, cetīnaṃ, vaṅgānaṃ, kurūnaṃ, pañcālānaṃ, macchānaṃ, sūrasenānaṃ, assakānaṃ, avantīnaṃ, gandhārānaṃ, kambojānaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ n'āgghati soḷasiṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?

89546.grammar: pr, from na anukampati, neg, trans (+acc)
89546.meaning1: does not care (for); does not take pity (on); has no compassion (for)
89546.construction:
na + anu + kampa + ti
na + anukampati

examples.text: abhave nandati tassa, bhave tassa na nandati, accheraṃ bhojanaṃ laddhā, tassa n'uppajjate sati, tato naṃ n'ānukampati, aho so'pi labheyy'ito.

89547.meaning1: to amass; to accumulate; to collect

examples.text: theyyena kūṭakammena ca pariyesati, theyyena musāvādena ca pariyesati, kūṭakammena musāvādena ca pariyesati. saṅghātun'ti saṅgharituṃ.

89548.commentary: (ANa) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti dhammatakko vuccati sammāsaṅkappo, so ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti dhammatakkapurejavo. taṃ dhammatakkapurejavaṃ.

examples.text: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanan'ti.

89549.meaning1: in one place; in a single location

examples.text: mama su'daṃ, bhikkhave, pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti. ekattha su'daṃ, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vappati, ekattha padumaṃ, ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ, yāva'd'eva mam'atthāya. na kho pan'ass'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, akāsikaṃ candanaṃ dhāremi.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, ekaṃ samūhanitvā ekattha uposathaṃ kātuṃ. evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, samūhantabbaṃ.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vidhuro hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.

89552.meaning1: having spun around; having circled around

examples.text: abhisaṅkhārassa gatī'ti payogassa gamanaṃ. ciṅgulāyitvā'ti paribbhamitvā. akkh'āhataṃ maññe'ti akkhe pavesetvā ṭhapitam'iva.
paribhāseyya vā'ti bhayaṃ upadaṃseti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhatt'agge antaraghare bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ ananulomikaṃ kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ upadaṃsenti, hatthaparāmāsaṃ karonti.

89554.meaning1: having jumped over; having leapt over
89554.meaning2: having jumped over; having leaped over
89554.commentary: (JAa) catutthe laṅghayitvānā'ti catutthe sattithale apatitvā attānaṃ laṅghayitvā.

examples.text: atikaram'akar'ācariya, mayham'p'etaṃ na ruccati, catutthe laṅghayitvāna, pañcamāya'si āvuto'ti.

89555.commentary: (JAa) pañcamāya'si āvuto'ti paṇḍitānaṃ vacanaṃ aggaṇhanto idāni pañcamāya sattiyā āvuto'sī'ti. idaṃ vatvā ācariyaṃ sattito apanetvā kattabbayuttakaṃ akāsi.

examples.text: atikaram'akar'ācariya, mayham'p'etaṃ na ruccati, catutthe laṅghayitvāna, pañcamāya'si āvuto'ti.

89556.meaning1: having a body; with a body

examples.text: tīhi vijjāhi sampannaṃ, asammūḷhavihārinaṃ, buddhaṃ antimadehinaṃ, taṃ namassanti gotamaṃ.

89557.meaning1: untangling the tangle; disentangling the confusion

examples.text: ettha ca bhagavā jaṭāvijaṭanaṃ pucchito sīlaṃ ārabhanto na aññaṃ puṭṭho aññaṃ kathetī'ti veditabbo. jaṭāvijaṭakassa hi patiṭṭhādassan'attham'ettha sīlaṃ kathitaṃ.

tasmā vuttanayen'eva nisīditvā app'assādā kāmā'ti-ādinā nayena kāmesu ādīnavaṃ paccavekkhitvā kāmanissaraṇe sabbadukkhasamatikkam'upāyabhūte nekkhamme jāt'ābhilāsena buddha-dhamma-saṅgha-guṇ'ānussaraṇena pītipāmojjaṃ janayitvā ayaṃ dāni sā sabbabuddha paccekabuddha ariyasāvakehi paṭipannā nekkhammapaṭipadā'ti paṭipattiyā sañjātagāravena addhā imāya paṭipadāya pavivekasukharasassa bhāgī bhavissāmī'ti ussāhaṃ janayitvā samena ākārena cakkhūni ummīletvā nimittaṃ gaṇhantena bhāvetabbaṃ.

89559.synonym: adhippāya, apekkhā, abhijappā, icchā, kamyatā, kāmatā, jappā, nikanti, pihā
89559.commentary: (SNt) taṇhāya abhilāsaṃ katvā'ti etena sabbassa'pi abhisaṅkhāra-vuṭṭhi-teman'atthaṃ dīpeti. taṇhā hi sneho'ti vuttā.

examples.text: assutavā hi bālaputhujjano avijjāya aññāṇī hutvā taṇhāya abhilāsaṃ katvā kusal'ākusalakammaṃ āyūhati, taṃ kusal'ākusalakammaṃ paṭisandhiviññāṇassa paccayo hoti, paṭisandhiviññāṇ'ādīni nāmarūp'ādīnaṃ.

89560.meaning1: to state; to declare; to announce

examples.text: ek'aṃsena byākātun'ti ek'antena byākarituṃ. arahattāya paṭipanno'ti arahattamaggasamaṅgiṃ dasseti.
sabbassa no issarā tvan'ti amhākaṃ puññakammassa sabbassa tvaṃ issarā, ayaṃ imassa vipāko, ayaṃ imassā'ti byākarituṃ samatthā.
tattha vāl'odakan'ti makacivālehi parissāvitaudakaṃ. vāl'udakan'ti'pi pāṭho.

89565.meaning1: hard to give; difficult to grant

examples.text: jānāhi kho mahārāja, dukkhaṃ me dubbinodayaṃ, pahu samāno gajjasu, ekaṃ te duccajaṃ varaṃ.

89566.meaning1: hard to give up; difficult to abandon
89566.commentary: (JAa) te duccajā mādisakenā'ti bhātika, tvaṃ kilese pahāya ṭhito, ahaṃ pana kāmapaṅke nimuggo, tasmā mādisakena te kāmā duccajā.

examples.text: addhā hi saccaṃ vacanaṃ tav'etaṃ, yathā isī bhāsasi evam'etaṃ, kāmā ca me santi anapparūpā, te duccajā mādisakena bhikkhu.
addhā hi saccaṃ vacanaṃ tavetaṃ, yathā isī bhāsasi evam'etaṃ, kāmā ca me santi anapparūpā, te duccajā mādisakena bhikkhu.

89569.meaning1: having that result; with those consequences

examples.text: tattha lokīyati vicittākārato dissatī'ti cakkavāḷasaṅkhāto loko okāsaloko, saṅkhāro lujjati palujjatī'ti loko, lokīyati ettha puññapāpaṃ tabbipāko cā'ti sattaloko.
puggalan'ti sattaṃ. so hi yathāpaccayaṃ kusal'ākusalānaṃ tabbipākānañ'ca pūraṇato maraṇavasena galanato ca puggalo'ti vuccati. paduṭṭhacittan'ti padosena āghātena duṭṭhacittaṃ.

89570.meaning1: having indicated; having signified; having demonstrated

examples.text: vemajjhe chinnassa chavasarīrass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. ito ca etto ca vividhākārena soṇa-siṅgāl'ādīhi khāyitan'ti vikkhāyitaṃ, vikhāyitan'ti vattabbe vikkhāyitan'ti vuttaṃ. vikkhāyitam'eva vikkhāyitakaṃ, paṭikūlattā vā kucchitaṃ vikkhāyitan'ti vikkhāyitakaṃ.

89574.meaning1: taken improperly; wrongly apprehended; understood in the wrong way
89574.meaning2: taken improperly; grasped badly or wrongly; wrongly apprehended

89575.commentary: (JAa) pañcamāya'si āvuto'ti paṇḍitānaṃ vacanaṃ aggaṇhanto idāni pañcamāya sattiyā āvuto'sī'ti. idaṃ vatvā ācariyaṃ sattito apanetvā kattabbayuttakaṃ akāsi.

examples.text: atikaram'akar'ācariya, mayham'p'etaṃ na ruccati, catutthe laṅghayitvāna, pañcamāya'si āvuto'ti.

89577.meaning1: able to grasp; capable of grabbing

examples.text: yasmā daharakāle suppasannāni sukhumam'pi attano visayaṃ sukhen'eva ca gaṇhanasamatthāni cakkh'ādīni indriyāni jaraṃ pattassa paripakkāni ālulitāni avisadāni oḷārikam'pi attano visayaṃ gahetuṃ asamatthāni honti, tasmā indriyānaṃ paripāko'ti'pi phal'ūpacāren'eva vuttā.

yasmā daharakāle suppasannāni sukhumam'pi attano visayaṃ sukhen'eva ca gaṇhanasamatthāni cakkh'ādīni indriyāni jaraṃ pattassa paripakkāni ālulitāni avisadāni oḷārikam'pi attano visayaṃ gahetuṃ asamatthāni honti, tasmā indriyānaṃ paripāko'ti'pi phal'ūpacāren'eva vuttā.

yasmā daharakāle suppasannāni sukhumam'pi attano visayaṃ sukhen'eva ca gaṇhanasamatthāni cakkh'ādīni indriyāni jaraṃ pattassa paripakkāni ālulitāni avisadāni oḷārikam'pi attano visayaṃ gahetuṃ asamatthāni honti, tasmā indriyānaṃ paripāko'ti'pi phal'ūpacāren'eva vuttā.

89580.meaning1: reference to the consequence of something, not the thing itself

examples.text: yasmā daharakāle suppasannāni sukhumam'pi attano visayaṃ sukhen'eva ca gaṇhanasamatthāni cakkh'ādīni indriyāni jaraṃ pattassa paripakkāni ālulitāni avisadāni oḷārikam'pi attano visayaṃ gahetuṃ asamatthāni honti, tasmā indriyānaṃ paripāko'ti'pi phal'ūpacāren'eva vuttā.

89582.grammar: nt, pp of na marati, neg
89582.commentary: (JAa) amatam'ādāyā'ti attano ānubhāvena ṭhito gaṅg'odakaṃ gahetvā abhisiñcayī'ti attho.

examples.text: tato amatam'ādāya, abhisiñci mahīruhaṃ, tassa sākhā virūhiṃsu, sītacchāyā manoramā.
kusītaṃ ekakaṃ vuttaṃ, sutt'antā tīṇi pañcakā, bāvīsati vuttā suttā, dutiyo vaggo pavuccatī'ti.

89584.commentary: (DNt) aññamaggapaṭikkhepan'atthan'ti titthiyehi parikappitassa maggassa dukkhanirodhagāminipaṭipadābhāvapaṭikkhepanatthaṃ, aññassa vā maggabhāvapaṭikkhepo aññamaggapaṭikkhepo, tadatthaṃ.

examples.text: ayam'evā'ti aññamaggapaṭikkhepan'atthaṃ niyamanaṃ.
niyyān'āvaraṇ'aṭṭhenā'ti niyyānānaṃ āgamanamaggapidahan'aṭṭhena. niyyānavāraṇ'aṭṭhen'ā'ti'pi pāṭho, niyyānānaṃ paṭikkhepan'aṭṭhenā'ti attho.
yehi cakkaratanena saddhiṃ ākāse samparivattamānehi tīṇi cakkāni ekato parivattantāni viya khāyanti. ayam'assa sabbaso sabb'ākāraparipūratā.
sukhaṃ supatī'ti yathā sesajanā samparivattamānā kākacchamānā dukkhaṃ supanti, evaṃ asupitvā sukhaṃ supati.

89587.meaning1: inner court; inner circle; inner family
89587.commentary: (ANa) idāni yattha sā saṃvidahitabbā, taṃ dassento antojanasmin'ti-ādim'āha. tatr'āyaṃ saṅkhep'attho, antojanasaṅkhātaṃ puttadāraṃ sīlasaṃvare patiṭṭhāpento vatthagandham'ālādīni c'assa dadamāno sabb'opaddave c'assa nivārayamāno dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati nāma.

examples.text: dhammo, bhikkhū'ti bhagavā avoca, idha, bhikkhu, rājā cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati antojanasmiṃ.

tatr'āyaṃ saṅkhep'attho, antojanasaṅkhātaṃ puttadāraṃ sīlasaṃvare patiṭṭhāpento vatthagandham'ālādīni c'assa dadamāno sabb'opaddave c'assa nivārayamāno dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahati nāma. khattiy'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

89590.meaning1: in one place; in one instance

examples.text: evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janan'ti. evan'ti opammasampaṭipādanaṃ. piyāyitaṃ janan'ti mamāyitaṃ janaṃ mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā bhātaraṃ vā bhaginiṃ vā puttaṃ vā dhītaraṃ vā mittaṃ vā amaccaṃ vā ñātiṃ vā sālohitaṃ vā'ti, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ.

89592.meaning1: this particular; these specific; limited to these
89592.commentary: (VINa) ettakehi bhesajjehi pavāremī'ti nāmavasena sappitel'ādīsu dvīhi tīhi vā parimāṇavasena patthena nāḷiyā āḷhakenā'ti vā.

examples.text: bhesajjapariyantā nāma bhesajjāni pariggahitāni honti, ettakehi bhesajjehi pavāremī'ti. rattipariyantā nāma rattiyo pariggahitāyo honti, ettakāsu rattīsu pavāremī'ti.

89593.meaning1: end of the spiritual journey; epithet of Nibbāna
89593.commentary: (NIDD2) tiṇṇo ca pāran'ti pāraṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedagum'ābhijaññā, akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ, addhā hi so ogham'imaṃ atāri, tiṇṇo ca pāraṃ akhilo akaṅkho.

kam'ettha brāhmaṇā paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā'ti? yo so, bho gotama, māṇavako ajjhāyako upanīto tam'ettha brāhmaṇā paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā.

idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu adhikaraṇiko hoti, adhikaraṇasamathassa na vaṇṇavādī. yam'pi, bhikkhave, bhikkhu adhikaraṇiko hoti adhikaraṇasamathassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayam'pi dhammo na piyatāya na garutāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
tatth'āyaṃ samayo. diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo pariḷāhasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo'ti.
tesaṃ āyunā'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi parihāyamānānaṃ pañcavassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ app'ekacce aḍḍhateyyavassasahass'āyukā, app'ekacce dvevassasahass'āyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dukkhassa gati paṭisaraṇan'ti duggati. dukkaṭakārino ettha vinipatantī'ti vinipāto.

89598.meaning1: intentional; deliberate; of which one is aware

examples.text: tisamuṭṭhānaṃ, kāyacittato vācācittato kāyavācācittato ca samuṭṭhāti. kiriyaṃ, saññāvimokkhaṃ, sacittakaṃ, paṇṇattivajjaṃ, kāyakammaṃ, vacīkammaṃ, ticittaṃ, tivedanan'ti.

89599.meaning1: make use of; puts to use; uses up

examples.text: anāpatti, pakatiyā chandā dosā mohā bhayā karontaṃ kv'attho tassa dinnena laddhā'pi vinipātessati na sammā upanessatī'ti khiyyati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
